description: This is a shell script used for testing and visualizing git log graphs, particularly focusing on complex merge scenarios like octopus merges with tricky or crossover cases. It defines tests to compare git log graph outputs with and without color, verifying the correctness of graphical representations of commit history.

methods.name: test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Compares the actual git log --graph output against an expected output file, ensuring the graph matches the expected visual representation.

methods.name: test_cmp_colored_graph
methods.description: Similar to test_cmp_graph, but compares colored graph outputs.
